  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductDevelopment" name="Product idea and prototype evaluation" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RD" name="R&D team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Idea</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DraftConcepts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectDesign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildPrototype</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestPrototype</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Idea" name="Begin product idea process">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Identify</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyIdea" name="Identify product idea or improvement">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Identify_Research</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResearchFeasibility" name="Conduct initial research and feasibility studies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Identify_Research</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Research_Concepts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftConcepts" name="Draft design concepts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Research_Concepts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Concepts_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select promising design">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Concepts_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Build</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Build</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test prototype functionality, safety, and market potential">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Build_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refine_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Feedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect testing feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Feedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_Refinement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" name="Is refinement needed?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_Refinement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refinement_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refinement_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refinement_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refine_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrototypeOutcome" name="Prototype decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refinement_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Discarded</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Approved for further development">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Research_Concepts" sourceRef="Task_ResearchFeasibility" targetRef="Task_DraftConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Concepts_Select" sourceRef="Task_DraftConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Build" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Feedback" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_Refinement" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refinement_Yes" name="Refinement needed" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refinement_No" name="No refinement needed" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_PrototypeOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_Test" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Approved" name="Approved for further development" sourceRef="Gateway_PrototypeOutcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Discarded" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_PrototypeOutcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded"/>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a process can end in one of multiple mutually exclusive outcomes: Model an exclusive gateway with a separate branch for each outcome, leading to the corresponding modeled outcome.
rules.situation: the description states that a process can end in one of multiple mutually exclusive outcomes

rules.instruction: When the description gives contextual details or examples alongside a single activity, without presenting them as separate actions: label the BPMN task with its core action and object; omit contextual details and qualifiers that are not needed to identify the activity
rules.situation: the description gives contextual details or examples alongside a single activity without presenting them as separate actions

rules.instruction: When the description says a process begins when a participant performs an identifiable action that establishes the process trigger: Model a start event for the trigger, followed by a separate task for the participant’s action; do not represent the action only as a start event.
rules.situation: the description says a participant performs an identifiable action that establishes the process trigger

rules.instruction: When the description names an activity or outcome with multiple stated actions, alternatives, or a distinguishing object or participant.: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or event so its described scope remains identifiable. Preserve materially stated actions, alternatives, and objects or participants; do not substitute a broader or different action or add unsupported details.
rules.situation: the description specifies an activity’s purpose or distinguishing object
